tools.description: Cancels backfilling for the given table UUIDs and/or history table UUIDs.
tools.name: Cancel_backfill

tools.description: Creates a new PrivateLink connection for the authenticated company.
tools.name: Create_a_PrivateLink_connection

tools.description: Creates a new Snowflake virtual warehouse using an unsaved connector configuration. Useful during initial setup to provision compute resources for data replication.
tools.name: Create_a_Snowflake_warehouse_on_an_unsaved_connector

tools.description: Creates a new column hashing salt for the authenticated company.
tools.name: Create_a_column_hashing_salt

tools.description: Creates a new source or destination connector for your Artie deployment. Configure database connections, authentication, and replication settings programmatically.
tools.name: Create_a_connector

tools.description: Creates a new database on the target destination using a connector configuration that has not yet been saved. Useful during initial setup to prepare the destination.
tools.name: Create_a_database_on_an_unsaved_connector

tools.description: Creates a new pipeline from a pipeline payload.
tools.name: Create_a_pipeline

tools.description: Creates a new schema on the target destination using a connector configuration that has not yet been saved. Useful during initial setup to organize destination tables.
tools.name: Create_a_schema_on_an_unsaved_connector

tools.description: Creates a new source reader for the authenticated company.
tools.name: Create_a_source_reader

tools.description: Creates a new SSH tunnel for the authenticated company.
tools.name: Create_an_SSH_tunnel

tools.description: Creates a new encryption key for the authenticated company.
tools.name: Create_an_encryption_key

tools.description: Creates a new ingestion API key for a source reader. Returns the key and its secret (only shown once).
tools.name: Create_an_ingestion_API_key

tools.description: Creates a new pipeline from a source type or existing source connector UUID.
tools.name: Create_pipeline_from_source

tools.description: Permanently deletes a PrivateLink connection by UUID. This action cannot be undone and will remove the connection from your account.
tools.name: Delete_a_PrivateLink_connection

tools.description: Deletes a column hashing salt by UUID.
tools.name: Delete_a_column_hashing_salt

tools.description: Permanently removes a connector and its associated configuration. This stops any active replication pipelines that depend on the connector.
tools.name: Delete_a_connector

tools.description: Permanently deletes a source reader by UUID. The source reader must not be associated with any active pipelines before deletion.
tools.name: Delete_a_source_reader

tools.description: Permanently deletes an SSH tunnel by UUID. The tunnel must not be in use by any connectors or pipelines before it can be deleted.
tools.name: Delete_an_SSH_tunnel

tools.description: Deletes an encryption key by UUID.
tools.name: Delete_an_encryption_key

tools.description: Deletes an ingestion API key by UUID.
tools.name: Delete_an_ingestion_API_key

tools.description: Deletes a pipeline by UUID.
tools.name: Delete_pipeline

tools.description: Deploys a shared source reader to the data plane. The source reader must be shared and pass validation before it can be deployed.
tools.name: Deploy_a_source_reader

tools.description: Enqueues a background job that checks the pipeline's source database for new, removed, or altered tables. If the pipeline has auto-replicate or auto-history mode enabled, any newly discovered tables will be added to the pipeline automatically. An email summary is sent if changes are detected.
tools.name: Detect_schema_changes

tools.description: Drops a PostgreSQL replication slot that is inactive or orphaned. Use this to clean up stale replication slots that may be preventing WAL cleanup on the source.
tools.name: Drop_a_PostgreSQL_replication_slot

tools.description: Lists available databases on the target using an unsaved connector configuration. Useful during connector setup to discover existing databases. Response metadata may include Iceberg S3 table bucket maintenance defaults.
tools.name: Fetch_databases_for_an_unsaved_connector

tools.description: Lists available schemas in a specific database using an unsaved connector configuration. Useful during connector setup to discover existing schemas.
tools.name: Fetch_schemas_for_an_unsaved_connector

tools.description: Returns detailed metadata for a specific table on the saved connector. Requires 'schemaName' and 'tableName' query parameters; 'isView' is optional.
tools.name: Fetch_table_detail_for_a_saved_connector

tools.description: Lists available tables in a specific database and schema using an unsaved connector configuration. Results are cached when a connector UUID is provided.
tools.name: Fetch_tables_for_an_unsaved_connector

tools.description: Generates the SQL script to create shadow tables required for Oracle change data capture (CDC). Run this script on your Oracle source before starting replication.
tools.name: Generate_Oracle_shadow_table_script

tools.description: Retrieves the details of a PrivateLink connection by UUID, including its status, VPC service name, region, DNS entry, and availability zones.
tools.name: Get_a_PrivateLink_connection

tools.description: Retrieves a column hashing salt by UUID, including the decrypted salt. Requires company admin.
tools.name: Get_a_column_hashing_salt

tools.description: Retrieves the full configuration and status of a connector by its unique identifier, including connection settings and current replication state.
tools.name: Get_a_connector

tools.description: Retrieves the details of a source reader by UUID, including its configuration, status, connector association, and table settings.
tools.name: Get_a_source_reader

tools.description: Retrieves the details of an SSH tunnel by UUID, including its host, port, username, public key, and whether it is currently in use.
tools.name: Get_an_SSH_tunnel

tools.description: Retrieves an encryption key by UUID, including the decrypted key. Requires company admin.
tools.name: Get_an_encryption_key

tools.description: Returns pipeline detail. With query includeRelatedObjects=true returns pipeline, sourceReader, sourceConnector, and optional destinationConnector; otherwise returns FullPipeline only.
tools.name: Get_pipeline_by_UUID

tools.description: Lists logical replication publications on a PostgreSQL source using an unsaved connector configuration. Useful during connector setup to let users select an existing publication.
tools.name: List_PostgreSQL_publications_for_an_unsaved_connector

tools.description: Lists all column hashing salts for the authenticated company.
tools.name: List_column_hashing_salts

tools.description: Lists all encryption keys for the authenticated company.
tools.name: List_encryption_keys

tools.description: Returns pipelines for the authenticated company, optionally filtered by environment.
tools.name: List_pipelines

tools.description: Lists all source readers for the authenticated company.
tools.name: List_source_readers

tools.description: Tests network connectivity and authentication for a saved connector.
tools.name: Ping_a_connector

tools.description: Hashes a sample string value with this salt using the same function used by Artie's pipelines (HMAC-SHA256 keyed on the salt, or SHA-256 if the salt is empty). Returns the hex-encoded hash.
tools.name: Preview_a_column_hashing_salt

tools.description: Searches across the company's data catalog using full-text search.
tools.name: Search_the_data_catalog

tools.description: Initiates a point-in-time export from Amazon DynamoDB for the specified connector. Use this to backfill your destination with existing DynamoDB table data.
tools.name: Start_a_DynamoDB_export

tools.description: Starts or resumes a pipeline. Optional body: keepPaused, disableBackFill.
tools.name: Start_pipeline

tools.description: Updates an existing PrivateLink connection by UUID. The name can always be updated. The config fields (region / VPC service name / data plane / availability zones) are only mutable while the connection is under review or errored — once it is being provisioned or live they are immutable.
tools.name: Update_a_PrivateLink_connection

tools.description: Updates the name and description of a column hashing salt.
tools.name: Update_a_column_hashing_salt

tools.description: Updates the configuration of an existing source or destination connector. Modify connection settings, credentials, or replication parameters for a running pipeline.
tools.name: Update_a_connector

tools.description: Updates an existing source reader by UUID. You can modify the name, settings, table configuration, and shared status of the source reader.
tools.name: Update_a_source_reader

tools.description: Updates an existing SSH tunnel by UUID. You can modify the name, host, port, and username. Changes will mark associated pipelines as having undeployed changes.
tools.name: Update_an_SSH_tunnel

tools.description: Updates the name and description of an encryption key.
tools.name: Update_an_encryption_key

tools.description: Updates an existing ingestion API key by UUID.
tools.name: Update_an_ingestion_API_key

tools.description: Updates an existing pipeline by UUID.
tools.name: Update_pipeline

tools.description: Changes the status of a pipeline (e.g. running, paused). Validates the pipeline before resuming and deploys the configuration change.
tools.name: Update_pipeline_status

tools.description: Updates pipeline and optionally its source reader in one request. Accepts gzip-encoded body.
tools.name: Update_pipeline_with_source_reader

tools.description: Changes the status of a shared source reader (e.g. running, paused). Only shared source readers are supported; for non-shared source readers, use the pipeline status endpoint instead.
tools.name: Update_source_reader_status

tools.description: Validates a source reader configuration without persisting it.
tools.name: Validate_an_unsaved_source_reader

tools.description: Validates destination configuration without persisting. Returns 204 on success or 200 with error message on validation failure.
tools.name: Validate_unsaved_destination

tools.description: Validates source reader and connector configuration without persisting. Returns 204 on success or 200 with error message on validation failure.
tools.name: Validate_unsaved_source
